Given the greasy yellow scales on the scalp and forehead of a 3-month-old, this presentation is classic for infantile seborrheic dermatitis, also known as cradle cap. Since the biopsy was normal and there are no signs of systemic illness, I am confident in this diagnosis.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Infantile seborrheic dermatitis
